description: This file declares the MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend class, which provides an interface for querying supported key systems and their versions related to media key capabilities. It includes method declarations for retrieving supported key systems, checking support for a specific key system, and obtaining the version of a key system. The class uses a singleton pattern and holds a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilities interface.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to media key capabilities, including supported key systems and their versions.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system identifiers.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported, returning an OpenCDMError code.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of a supported key system.
